# Code Review — 2026-08-13

Scope: full `src/` tree (~8.6k lines TS/TSX), `index.html`, workflows, config. Evidence base: direct file reads, `gh` API state, `npm run coverage` output, asset inventory of `public/` and `dist/`.

## Findings

- [ ] **[UX/DX] Stale tool count and missing Meet entry in SEO metadata**
  - **Status quo:** `index.html:17,26,35` still says "16 open-source, local-first tools" in the meta description, `og:description` and `twitter:description`, and the JSON-LD `ItemList` (`index.html:64-81`) lists only 16 `SoftwareApplication` entries — Symaira Meet is missing. `README.md:16` and the route table (`src/App.tsx:70`) both already present 17 tools including Meet. Search engines and social cards therefore contradict the site.
  - **Proposed solution:** Update the three meta strings to "17" and append a Meet entry (position 17) to the JSON-LD `ItemList` with the same shape as the existing entries.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact (SEO/GEO consistency).

- [ ] **[Architecture] Test coverage gate scopes only 4 of ~25 source files**
  - **Status quo:** `vitest.config.ts:11-19` restricts coverage collection and the 80% gate to `src/config/tune.ts`, `src/config/analytics.ts`, `src/components/TuneEditions.tsx` and `src/components/TuneFunnel.tsx`. The remaining ~8k lines (routing in `src/App.tsx`, consent flow in `src/components/CookieConsent.tsx`, language fallback in `src/context/LanguageContext.tsx`, the 1011-line `src/components/ToolPage.tsx`) have no tests at all and are invisible to the gate by design.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add behavior-focused suites for the highest-risk untested paths first: CookieConsent consent matrix (accept/decline/revoke, storage-blocked fallback), LanguageContext `t()` fallback chain and browser-language detection, App.tsx route/title mapping. Widen `coverage.include` per suite as it lands instead of one big-bang threshold.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / high impact.

- [ ] **[Performance] 9.6 MB of unreferenced product-logo PNGs shipped on every deploy**
  - **Status quo:** `public/brand/product-logos/` contains 24 PNGs at 1024x1024 and ~400 KB each (9.6 MB total). Nothing references them — no match for `product-logos` anywhere in `src/`, `index.html` or `public/llms.txt` — but Vite copies all of `public/` into `dist/`, so every FTPS deploy uploads them. Additionally the referenced `logo.png` is 936 KB and `logo-top.png`/`logo-bottom.png` are ~500 KB each.
  - **Proposed solution:** Decide intent for the product logos: if planned for tool pages, wire them in (ideally resized/compressed, e.g. 256px WebP); otherwise remove them from `public/` and keep them in a design asset store outside the deploy path. Compress the three referenced logos (target < 150 KB each).
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact (deploy time, page weight).

## Security notes (no findings)

- Consent flow is correctly fail-closed: `initGA` only runs after explicit opt-in (`src/components/CookieConsent.tsx:29-31,71-73`), `trackEvent` no-ops without consent (`src/config/analytics.ts:79`), GA params are type-restricted (`src/config/analytics.ts:77`), IP anonymization is explicit (`src/config/analytics.ts:42`).
- All 13 `target="_blank"` links carry `rel="noopener noreferrer"`; no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`/`eval` usage anywhere in `src/`.
- No secrets in the repo; GA measurement ID is a public identifier, not a secret.

## Conclusion

First quick win: the stale "16 tools" metadata fix (trivial, immediately visible in search/social previews). The structural lever is broadening the coverage gate beyond the Tune funnel — routing, consent and i18n are the site's most regression-prone behavior and currently untested.
